crossRefs.note: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom…
Now therefore, please swear to me by Yahweh, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my…
and bring these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand, and see how your brothers are doing, and bring back news.”

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: The greeting of me, Paul, with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter: this is how I write.
translations.bsb: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. This is my mark in every letter; it is the way I write.
translations.kjv: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
translations.asv: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
